# Canada.ca

> > Official website of the Government of Canada providing access to federal services, programs, and information across all departments and agencies.

Canada.ca serves as the primary digital gateway for Canadian citizens, businesses, and researchers to access government services, from employment insurance and pensions to national security oversight and research funding. The site consolidates information from departments including Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC), the Intelligence Commissioner, research granting agencies (CIHR, NSERC, SSHRC), and specialized bodies like Accessibility Standards Canada and Canadian Special Operations Forces Command.

## Key Topics

- Intelligence Commissioner oversight
- Communications Security Establishment (CSE)
- Canadian Security Intelligence Service (CSIS)
- Research funding and granting agencies
- Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC)
- National security and privacy protection
- Ministerial authorization and quasi-judicial review
- Canadian Institutes of Health Research (CIHR)
- Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council (NSERC)
- Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC)
- Accessibility standards and plain language
- Interprovincial trade barriers and labour mobility
- Special operations and defence
- Parliamentary testimony and oversight
- Early career researchers support

## Core Government Services

- [Employment and Social Development Canada - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development.html): ESDC main page: social programs, employment insurance, pensions
- [Accessibility Standards Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/accessibility-standards-canada.html): Accessibility Standards Canada: wayfinding, AI, plain language standards
- [One Canadian Economy - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/one-canadian-economy.html): One Canadian Economy Act reducing interprovincial barriers & trade

## Intelligence and National Security Oversight

- [Oversight - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/intelligence-commissioner/oversight-en.html): Intelligence Commissioner oversight of CSE and CSIS operations
- [Cybersecurity Authorization - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/intelligence-commissioner/oversight-en/cybersecurity.html): CSE cybersecurity authorization oversight and privacy protection
- [Remarks to the Standing Committee on Public Safety and National Security – October 30, 2025 - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/intelligence-commissioner/remarks-to-the-standing-committee-on-public-safety-and-national-security-october302025.html): Intelligence Commissioner testimony on cybersecurity oversight
- [Appearance before the Standing Committee on Public Safety and National Security – October 30, 2025 - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/intelligence-commissioner/remarks-to-the-standing-committee-on-public-safety-and-national-security-october302025/briefingpackageoctober2025.html): Bill C-8 briefing package for parliamentary committee appearance
- [Media Room - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/intelligence-commissioner/mediaroom.html): Intelligence Commissioner media releases and announcements

## Research Funding and Coordination

- [About the Canada Research Coordinating Committee - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/research-coordinating-committee/corporate/about-canada-research-coordinating-committee.html): CRCC mandate, membership, and research coordination overview
- [About the Canada Impact+ Research Chairs program - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/impact-plus-chairs/about.html): Canada Impact+ Research Chairs program governance and administration
- [Program details - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/impact-plus-chairs/program-details.html): Impact+ Research Chairs application process and selection criteria
- [Canada's research funding ecosystem - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/research-coordinating-committee/corporate/canadas-research-funding-ecosystem.html): Overview of tri-agency research funding ecosystem in Canada
- [Supporting early career researchers - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/research-coordinating-committee/priorities/support-early-career-researchers.html): CRCC priority supporting early career researchers funding programs

## Economic Development and Infrastructure

- [Building Canada Act – Projects of National Interest - One Canadian Economy - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/one-canadian-economy/services/building-canada-act-projects-national-interest.html): Building Canada Act projects of national interest criteria
- [Contracting Information for Suppliers - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/corporate/contracting.html): ESDC supplier contracting terms and procurement information

## Defence and Special Operations

- [Contact CANSOFCOM - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/special-operations-forces-command/corporate/contact.html): Contact info for Canadian Special Operations Forces Command
- [Job opportunities  - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/special-operations-forces-command/corporate/job-opportunities.html): CANSOFCOM job opportunities and recruitment information

## Optional

- [Gender-based analysis plus - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/intelligence-commissioner/corporate-management-reporting/gender-based-analysis-plus.html): GBA+ analysis for Intelligence Commissioner operations
